images.filename: Magdalen college oxford water meadow flooded 1.jpg
images.caption:
The water meadow at Magdalen College, Oxford, is an island in the river Cherwell and can flood after heavy rain. Due to this, it is one of the few places in the UK where snakes head fritillaries grow wild. 
In the background, the New Building is visible side-on.
images.alt:
The water meadow at Magdalen College, Oxford, is an island in the river Cherwell and can flood after heavy rain. Due to this, it is one of the few places in the UK where snakes head fritillaries grow wild. 
In the background, the New Building is visible side-on.

images.caption: Holywell Ford in the grounds of Magdalen College, Oxford. It is used for graduate student accommodation. Holywell Ford house (left) was built by Clapton Crabb Rolfe in 1888 on the location of an older mill, and was acquired by Magdalen in the 1970s. Additional blocks of accommodation (right) were built in 1994-5 by RH Partnership Ltd.
images.alt: Holywell Ford in the grounds of Magdalen College, Oxford. It is used for graduate student accommodation.
